message: You've spent the debate dodging actual arguments and instead resorting to the same established talking points. Your focus on the 'status quo' and 'ideological allies' suggests you might be more interested in preserving your position than finding effective solutions. It seems you're relying on a laundry list of empty slogans and feel-good buzzwords rather than proposing genuine solutions. This approach doesn't contribute to a serious discussion about drug-related issues.
